meta.policy: A plan exists only when trend and structure agree, the stop is inside the max distance, and reward:risk clears the configured floor. Entries at the quote fill immediately in the paper book; pullbacks, retests and reversals rest as working orders until the market trades to the level. Strategy never sizes a position and never places an order.
